EXT.evidence: Arranges and goes on a double date and discusses further social plans depending on how it goes (u008); assertively engages others about the date (u010).

AGR.evidence: Insults the date’s friend as a “pathetic mess,” “needy and vulnerable,” aims to exploit the situation, and pressures his friend to comply (u012, u010).

CON.evidence: Organizes the double date and ensures the agreed arrangement (bringing a friend) is kept, insisting his friend not bail (u010, u008).

NEU.evidence: Speaks with certainty and control—“you must not bail,” “you are going to do the double date,” and expects to benefit—showing confidence rather than anxiety (u010, u012).

OPN.evidence: No clear signs of curiosity or inventiveness; talk centers on logistics and coercion.
